description: Source code for SpdyProxyClientSocket class implementing a SPDY proxy client socket with connection, read/write, and delegate handling.

classes.name: SpdyProxyClientSocket
classes.description: Implements a SPDY proxy client socket handling connection, data transfer, and delegate callbacks.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Initiates connection with the proxy server, handling authentication and request setup.

methods.name: Disconnect
methods.description: Closes the connection and cleans up resources.

methods.name: IsConnected
methods.description: Checks if the socket is currently connected.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the socket into the provided buffer.

methods.name: OnHeadersReceived
methods.description: Handles received response headers from the SPDY stream.

methods.name: OnDataReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming data buffers from the SPDY stream.

methods.name: OnClose
methods.description: Handles closure of the SPDY stream, cleaning up state.
